description: Exact determinant of the H_3 Gram in both conventions, parsed from the committed Lean. Settles whether the supergolden 'phase collapse' is a real threshold (convention C: yes, and there is a second one at q = 1) or an artefact of a non-canonical frame (convention D: the determinant vanishes identically, so nothing is distinguished).
